s1.desc: a dim bedroom with a golden wooden bed, a duck-topped bedpost and pale bedding, drawn on a plain grey background

s2.desc: a dim room with a pale icy floor, a small round yellow lamp and an open laptop on the floor, drawn on a plain grey background

beats.text: Pax reclines against the pillow in bed with heavy-lidded eyes and a weary little smile
Pax blinks slowly and nods along, his eyes drooping

spans.notes: SLOW PUSH-IN, judgement call: the whole shot drifts in continuously (global scale +0.1% per 6 frames, +2.0% and ~20 px by f54; bedpost and headboard edges doubled red/green in compare 0/54). Beats written so the span can be flipped to keep if slow drift is accepted (the example PP-Chair [0,86) has the same kind of drift, +4%, and was kept)

beats.text: Polly hunches over a microphone with her eyes squeezed shut, belting out a song
Polly turns sideways and rocks back, still singing into the microphone
Polly faces the front and sings with her beak wide open
Polly flings one flipper out wide and belts with her beak stretched open and her eyes shut

spans.notes: SLOW PUSH-IN, judgement call: continuous drift, global scale +2.5% and ~25 px by f138 (laptop and lamp edges doubled in compare 55/138). Beats written so the span can be flipped if slow drift is accepted. No overlay, no phone (a laptop)

beats.text: Pax lies back against the pillow propping his cheek on a flipper, his eyes drooping
Pax lets his eyes fall shut and dozes off
Pax snaps his eyes open with a startled little jolt
